proposition: The Mafāḥiṣ carries a master diagram, the Ṭahawī Circle (a cosmological key spanning wujūd and kawn), a Ḥāmīmī Circle for the spoken form, and master number tables (jadāwil al-baḥr) meant as a key to all its issues.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
